option_relations.rationale: Sézary Syndrome is a leukemic variant of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, characterized by erythroderma and circulating Sézary cells. While related to CTCL, the provided leaf is specifically 'Mycosis Fungoides (tumor stage)', which is distinct from Sézary Syndrome.
The option 'Mycosis Fungoides (cutaneous T-cell lymphoma)' is a direct translation and clinical equivalent of the provided leaf '蕈样肉芽肿（肿瘤期）' which translates to Mycosis Fungoides (tumor stage).
Adult T-cell Leukemia/Lymphoma is a distinct type of T-cell lymphoma caused by HTLV-1 infection, with different clinical and pathological features than Mycosis Fungoides.
Ichthyosiform mycosis fungoides is a rare variant of Mycosis Fungoides, making it a subtype of the broader disease Mycosis Fungoides (tumor stage) represented by the leaf.
